sn44.9:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.9:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn44.9:2.1: purimāni bho gotama divasāni purimatarāni sambahulānaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakānaṃ kutuhalasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
sn44.9:2.2: ayaṃ kho pūraṇo kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa
sn44.9:2.3: so sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti
sn44.9:2.4: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:2.5: yopissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti
sn44.9:2.6: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:3.5: ayampi kho ajito kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa
sn44.9:3.6: sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ uppattīsu byākaroti
sn44.9:3.7: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:3.8: yopissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃpi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti
sn44.9:3.9: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.1: ayampi kho samaṇo gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa
sn44.9:4.2: sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti
sn44.9:4.3: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.5: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.7: acchejji taṇhaṃ vivattayi saññojanaṃ sammāmānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
sn44.9:4.8: tassa mayhaṃ bho gotama ahudeva kaṅkhā ahu vicikicchā
sn44.9:4.9: kathañhi nāma samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyoti.
sn44.9:5.1: alañhi te vaccha kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ
sn44.9:5.2: kaṅkhāniye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.
sn44.9:5.3: saupādānassa khvāhaṃ vaccha upapattiṃ paññapemi no anupādānassa.
sn44.9:5.4: seyyathāpi vaccha aggi saupādāno jalati no anupādāno
sn44.9:5.5: evameva khvāhaṃ vaccha saupādānassa upapattiṃ paññapemi no anupādānassāti.
sn44.9:6.1: yasmiṃ bho gotama samaye acci vātena khittā dūraṃpi gacchati imissā pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññapetīti.
sn44.9:6.2: yasmiṃ kho vaccha samaye acci vātena khittā dūraṃ gacchati tamahaṃ vātupādānaṃ paññapemi
sn44.9:6.3: vāto hissa vaccha tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotīti.
sn44.9:6.4: yasmiṃ bho gotama samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti. imassa pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññapetīti.
sn44.9:6.5: yasmiṃ kho vaccha samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti tamahaṃ taṇhupādānaṃ vadāmi
sn44.9:6.6: taṇhā hissa vaccha tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotīti.
